blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Eugenia “Eggie” Apostol, a veteran journalist and founding chairperson of the Philippine Daily Inquirer, has died at the age of 100. Her death was announced by the Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation (RMAF), which honored Apostol in 2006 for her contributions to journalism and press freedom. Apostol’s family has requested for privacy as they mourn her passing. “The Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation joins the journalistic community in mourning the passing of 2006 Ramon Magsaysay Awardee Eugenia Duran Apostol, journalist, publisher, and fearless champion of truth and press freedom,” the foundation said. “Through her journalism, she gave Filipinos the information […]...
